$about: The colours of the site, by role. build/tokens.mjs writes them into src/styles/base/tokens.gen.css as --c-<name> and checks every pair in `contrast` (WCAG 2 ratio). Styles never write a colour literally (build/rules.mjs).

One ink, cool grey #2d2f33, in alpha steps on light grounds (as the Figma variables «cool gray/NN»), white in alpha steps on dark ones. Grounds: white page, cloud #f6f6f6 for cards and tiles, cool grey for the business section, black for photos and the hero. Lavender is the brand's one colour: eyebrows and the active state, never a surface. Descriptor dots have their own small palette by flavour family (descriptors).

fades.$about: Fades from clear to a ground, eased (as github.com/enisbu/tw-easing-gradients): a straight two-stop gradient shows a hard edge where it ends; these follow a curve in `stops` steps, so a photo or a pack melts into the ground. One fade per place, each laid over the whole block it stands under, with no solid band below it (Tim, round 5); the block's padding-top is the lead-in above its content. `curve` is the cubic-bezier of the easing (0.5, 0, 0.5, 1 for every place: Tim's pick in the fade tuner, round 6 — an even S-curve that leaves the clear end and reaches the ground equally slowly), `reach` the share of the block's height at which the fade is full (1: at its foot). Tuned in the fade tuner (artifact, round 5). build/tokens.mjs writes each as --fade-<name> (--fade-<name>-<ground> for a place with two grounds): the stops of a linear-gradient(to bottom, …). Every gradient of the site is one of these or a solid band (build/rules.mjs).

hero.use: the hero: the photo into the black of its cells (lead-in --hero-fade)

top.use: the hero below L: from the navbar down over the photo, under the title at the top of the section (laid upside down: linear-gradient(to top, …); it runs --hero-fade past the title's foot)

caption.use: the caption over a new arrival's photo (lead-in 64px)

panel.use: the text of a business card (lead-in 40px) and of the business page's offers (2 × --block-pad)

card.use: the buy row of a product card and of a line in the bag, over the pack or the photo (lead-in 56px)

contrast.$about: text colour / ground / least ratio: 4.5 for text, 3 for large text (24px and up) and the parts of controls. ink-60 is only for large text (the inactive catalog tabs) and parts of controls (the hollow weight dot); ink-50 and lighter only for lines and decoration, but for ink-30: the inactive catalog tabs, on Tim's word (round 7, decision tabs-30). Secondary text is ink-70.

descriptors.$about: The dot before a descriptor: one colour per flavour family; the first family whose word appears in the descriptor wins. The dot is decoration (the word is the information), so it needs 3:1 only against its pill.
